svg.title: IFINDIT CHATGEN: assistants and agents connected to organizational knowledge
svg.desc: IFINDIT CHATGEN illustration: an employee asks the HR assistant how many vacation days they have left and how to request them. The agent shows its reasoning — it searched the internal regulations in the knowledge base, used the payroll tool and calculated the days — and replies that 9 working days remain, citing its sources. Around it are the vector knowledge base, the agent's tools and the channels: web widget, WhatsApp and search box. A map below shows that ChatGen is built from the PQRS Classifier, Search and Data Catalog, on the Auth IAM and LakeHouse base, and that its data also feeds the Dashboards.

g.text: How many vacation days do I have left
and how do I request them?
Submit a request through the employee
portal 15 days in advance, with approval
Search, Data Catalog and the PQRS
